topIssues.title: interop + batcher: Use Verification-Aware CurrentL1
topIssues.author: axelKingsley
topIssues.body:
The Batcher watches "CurrentL1" for the chain it is publishing, and does not expect this value to go backwards. However, if it is making calls into the Virtual Node, it is actually fetching the "Local" CurrentL1 view, which may revert on block invalidation/replacement.

The batcher should have a way to get a non-reverting view of currentL1 for this progression check. Currently the SuperRoot API does this by computing the minimum verified in addition to the local progression.

Batcher should fetch similar data in order to avoid getting stuck during reorgs, as is currently experienced in interop dev networks.

topPRs.title: feat: switch to OP Labs op-reth image with mounted Boba chain spec
topPRs.author: jyellick
topPRs.body:
## Summary

The `ghcr.io/paradigmxyz/op-reth` image our compose files reference is no longer maintained — op-reth ownership moved to OP Labs at v1.11.0. The new authoritative image at `us-docker.pkg.dev/oplabs-tools-artifacts/images/op-reth` does **not** include Boba as a built-in chain (the superchain-registry compile-time integration was dropped during the move).

This PR switches to the OP Labs image and supplies the Boba chain spec at runtime via a mounted JSON file.

- Add `boba-community/chainspecs/{boba,boba-sepolia}.json` (1.5KB each) extracted from `paradigmxyz/op-reth:v1.10.2 dump-genesis`
- Add `chainspecs/README.md` documenting the why and a regeneration procedure
- Switch `RETH_IMAGE` default to `us-docker.pkg.dev/oplabs-tools-artifacts/images/op-reth`, pin `RETH_VERSION` to `v2.2.1`
- Mount the chain spec JSON in compose files; replace `--chain=boba[-sepolia]` with `--chain=/config/<chain>.json`
- Update geth-to-reth migration guide and boba-docs to reflect the new image and mount

## Validation

Tested against a live Boba Sepolia snapshot using the new image + JSON chain spec:
- The OP Labs `op-reth:v2.2.1` opens the existing v1.10.2-format database without migration
- Sync resumes from the snapshot block and advances forward
- `op-node:v1.16.5` drives op-reth correctly via the Engine API
- `eth_chainId` returns `0x70d2` (28882) as expected

The extracted chain spec produces a byte-identical `OpChainSpec` when reloaded by the new image:
```bash
docker run --rm ghcr.io/paradigmxyz/op-reth:v1.10.2 dump-genesis --chain boba | tail -n +2 > /tmp/a.json
docker run --rm -v "$PWD/boba-community/chainspecs:/cs" us-docker.pkg.dev/oplabs-tools-artifacts/images/op-reth:v2.2.1 \
  dump-genesis --chain /cs/boba.json | tail -n +2 > /tmp/b.json
diff /tmp/a.json /tmp/b.json  # no diff
```

## Test plan
- [ ] Pull this branch and run `docker compose -f docker-compose-boba-sepolia-reth.yml up -d` against an existing reth-data directory; verify sync continues from current head
- [ ] Verify `eth_chainId` returns 28882 (sepolia) / 288 (mainnet)
- [ ] (optional) Run the migration `init` profile against a fresh state dump and confirm `init-state` produces an identical state root with the new `--chain=/config/<chain>.json` argument
